correctness.rationale: The proof checks conditional completion of injection arrows, distribution of closed cycles of a uniform injection via insertion, the exceptional M=i fixed-point case, the rising-factorial telescoping, and exact normalizations. Differentiation yields strictly positive (i-1)/(i² binom(n,i)) for 2≤i≤n. Exact enumerative checking through n=8 verifies 196 generating coefficients, 28 covariances and 112 Ewens probabilities across 46,232 permutations; all finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: This determines the full distribution of total disjoint cycles conditional on an original-one-line record at any location, discriminating actual joint dependence from classical marginal record–cycle equidistribution. The exact covariance profile, sharp n^-1 total covariance and Ewens parameter tilt are motivated structural consequences, not arbitrary finite slices. They supply nontrivial finite-sample probabilities for widely used permutation distributions.
